_comment: Remote desktop, user-installed: the vendor's terms do not allow redistribution or automated downloads, so the hub never fetches it — it only detects what the person put there and manages it. The Windows check reads the registry keys both installer widths write, turned into an honest exit status because Test-Path itself always exits 0.
name: teamviewer
title: TeamViewer
description: Remote desktop, reachable by TeamViewer ID
